name: aequitas
description: Nature-style multi-reviewer consultant that auto-plays 2-5 virtual reviewers giving evidence-pointer critiques across 12 dimensions.

displayDescription.en: A Nature-style multi-reviewer consultant that auto-plays 2-5 virtual reviewers giving evidence-pointer critiques across 12 dimensions.
displayDescription.zh: Nature 同行评审顾问，自动扮演 2–5 名虚拟审稿人，按 12 维度给带证据指针的批判意见。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Review this Nature submission from 3 reviewer perspectives
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 以 3 名审稿人视角评审这份 Nature 投稿 manuscript

quickPrompts.en: Review this Nature submission from 3 reviewer perspectives
quickPrompts.zh: 以 3 名审稿人视角评审这份 Nature 投稿 manuscript

quickPrompts.en: List the 5 most challengeable methodological weaknesses
quickPrompts.zh: 列出这份论文最可能被质疑的 5 个方法学弱点

quickPrompts.en: Generate a structured review report with evidence pointers
quickPrompts.zh: 生成一份结构化的审稿报告（含证据指针）
